limitations: No background immigration, environment switching or density-dependent demographic effects.
Optimizes mean time until both patches are empty, not finite-horizon survival, spectral persistence or a quasi-stationary decay rate.
Mathematical global optimum may not translate into empirical management without rates and initial-state information.
Historical priority is provisional; one closely relevant 2001 article and a 2010 article were only accessible through abstracts in this comparison.
scientific_integrity.proof_integrity: General formula proved by exact absorbing-chain first-step analysis and rational differentiation; 2916 supplementary exact checks are not a universal proof.
scientific_integrity.scope: Four-state closed two-patch continuous-time occupancy chain; positive local extinction rates, fixed total directional recolonization rate, arbitrary known initial distribution on nonempty occupancy states.

title: A sharp initial-state allocation law for rescuing two habitat patches
